text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *wheeze*, *gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I... I...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
――~~Yeah!
Yeah, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I got 1st place!
I really, truly won!

text_block_list.name: Roar of the Crowd
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Gah!?
Whoa, what a loud voice...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You did it, Haru Urara!
You really did it... You really... *sniff*!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Urara-chan... *sniff*,
uwaaah, congratulations!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*, *sniffle*,
you're amazing, Urara-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local C
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, urk, oooogh!
Oooohhh...... oooohhh...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Is everyone crying, by any chance?
Huh, why~!?"
choice_data_list: Because I'm happy you won, Urara.
Because I'm happy you won, Urara.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Are you crying out of happiness?
Geez, you can't do that~!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, you've gotta be smiling!
I just wanted to make you all happy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I just wanted to make everyone smile!
So give me a smile as my reward!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text: Urara-chan...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*, you're right.
This is Urara-chan's big moment, after all.
I gotta smile!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local C
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Urara-chan,
congratulations... congratulations...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup, yeah!
Thank you for cheering for me, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Urara-chan!
I'm frustrated, but still... Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, I never thought the day would come
where I'd lose to Urara.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... You say that,
but your eyes are all red.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: La-la, I can't hear anythiiing.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!
Ehehe, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I was so happy I got to run with everyone!
Because before, I was always just watching from behind!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I've gotten stronger, haven't I?
Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Taking 1st place is wonderful!
Far, far more than I ever dreamed!

And so, Haru Urara gave it her absolute all
on the stage of her dreams!
